verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for an AI assistant and coding CLI. The evidence pack never documents any telemetry, analytics, or usage-tracking opt-out control for Kimi, Kimi Code CLI, or the IDE extension. The Admin API's usage and audit logs and the per-project usage tracking are billing features, not privacy opt-outs, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
